prose: Juan Ayala and Homie Romie team up to present their research into the fractal resonance of temple tech. We discuss arithmetic archetypes, symbolism in stone, the mystery of the cube, planetary algorithms, hidden hyperspace kingdoms, the astral meta-verse, and the tomb of Christian Rosenkreutz.
ext: In the oversized extension, we review the allegorical Pythagoras, the temple as body, LSPR and ancient nanotech, musical architecture, the mundus imaginalis, structures for scrying, the apotheosis of George Washington, and much more!
